raw.etymology_text: From Middle High German bluome m or f, from Old High German bluomo m, bluoma f, from Proto-West Germanic *blōmō (“flower”), which see for cognates. The masculine used to be chiefly Upper German, the feminine chiefly Central German. The latter was later reinforced by Middle Low German blôme (exclusively feminine). Analogy with Blüte and Pflanze may also have contributed.
